scripts.//test:unit: shared espone dist/index.js: senza compilarlo prima, backend e frontend non risolvono @codeguardian/shared e undici file di test muoiono in import. `pnpm -r run test` da solo non lo compila, perche' shared non ha uno script test e viene saltato.
scripts.test:unit: pnpm --filter @codeguardian/shared run build && pnpm -r run test
scripts.test:integration: pnpm test:integration:up && pnpm test:integration:test; pnpm test:integration:down
scripts.test:cov: pnpm --filter @codeguardian/shared run build && pnpm -r run test:cov
